sections.subhead: Fix What's Blocking Google Before Content and Links Can Do Their Job

body.html: Technical SEO Services Kochi — that's what businesses search for once content and backlinks aren't moving rankings the way they should. Teknoppy's technical SEO work clears the underlying issues stopping Google from crawling, indexing, and understanding a site properly, since no amount of content fixes a site Google can't even read correctly.

Choosing the right Technical SEO Services Kochi provider matters because technical problems are often invisible to a business owner but obvious to search engines — a site can look fine to a visitor while quietly losing rankings to crawl errors, duplicate content, or broken indexing nobody's checking.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — Technical SEO Services Kochi

items.q: How is technical SEO different from on-page SEO?
items.a: Technical SEO focuses on how search engines crawl, index, and understand your site — sitemaps, structured data, site architecture. On-page SEO focuses on individual page content, titles, and headings. Both matter, but technical issues have to be fixed first for on-page work to fully count.

items.q: How do I know if my site has technical SEO problems?
items.a: Common signs include stalled rankings despite good content, pages missing from Google Search Console's index, duplicate content warnings, or slow crawl activity. A technical SEO audit Kochi identifies these clearly rather than leaving it to guesswork.

items.q: Will technical SEO fixes affect my current rankings?
items.a: Done correctly, technical fixes protect and improve rankings rather than risk them. Canonical and redirect changes are handled carefully and monitored closely to avoid unintended ranking drops during implementation.

items.q: Do you fix duplicate content issues?
items.a: Yes. Duplicate content fix SEO work identifies competing or near-identical pages and resolves them through canonicalization, consolidation, or redirects, depending on what's causing the duplication.

items.q: Is structured data part of technical SEO?
items.a: Yes. Structured data implementation services are a core part of our technical work, helping both traditional search engines and AI answer engines understand your content accurately.

items.q: How long does a technical SEO project take?
items.a: Initial fixes are typically completed within 2–4 weeks of the audit, though technical SEO is best maintained as an ongoing part of ranking work rather than a one-time project.
